messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Announcement: new function for filtering record tables
parts:
A new function filterRecordTable is available in the GitHub version of camtrapR. It performs temporal filtering of existing record tables and replaces the workaround using camtrapr:::assessTemporalIndependence I suggested in the past.

Install via:
# install.packages("remotes") # if not installed
# install.packages("R.rsp")   # if not installed
remotes::install_github("jniedballa/camtrapR", build_vignettes = TRUE)

Note that it is currently only available for species record tables (as created by recordTable), not for individual record tables (as created by recordTableIndividual).

Please let me know if there are any problems.

Thank you,
Jürgen

I'm working with some pre-existing camera trap data in an Excel spreadsheet, and I'm excited to use this function. I had some trouble at first but realized I had to unload the CRAN R version of camtrapR to install the github version, then load the CRAN version back in to use the filterRecordTable function.

However, now I'm running into a Date/Time issue - below is the error I keep getting.

> fourspecies_filt <- filterRecordTable( + recordTable = four_species, + minDeltaTime = 15, + deltaTimeComparedTo = "lastIndependentRecord", + speciesCol = "species", + stationCol = "deploymentName", + camerasIndependent = TRUE, + recordDateTimeCol = "DateTimeOriginal", + recordDateTimeFormat = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", + removeDuplicateRecords = TRUE, + timeZone = "America/Los_Angeles", + writecsv = TRUE, + ) Error in filterRecordTable(recordTable = four_species, minDeltaTime = 15, : recordDateTimeCol 'DateTimeOriginal' could not be converted to a date-time object.

Below is how I (tried to) convert my separate date and time columns into a date-time object. 

four_species$DateTimeOriginal <- strptime(paste(as.Date(four_species$date, format = "%m/%d/%Y"), four_species$time), format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "America/Los_Angeles")

four_species$DateTimeTest <- as.POSIXct(four_species$DateTimeOriginal, tz = "America/Los_Angeles")
